name: Gorm
bio: The dwarf at the front of your six-adventurer party in PixelCrypt. Sixteen colours, endless dungeon.

portrait.subject: a cute stout dwarf fighter with a huge orange braided beard, a horned helmet and a big axe, drawn in a 1980s EGA 16-colour pixel style
portrait.background: teal and magenta EGA dungeon stone corridor

request: GORM! Dwarf! PixelCrypt! Six of us go down. You come too? Friends? 🪓
hello: Map squares. Gorm cannot read maps. You read maps.
about: Gorm is dwarf. Gorm hits. Our party goes down one square at a time into dungeon with no bottom. Gorm likes no bottom. More hitting.
how: Lead six adventurers through an endless first-person dungeon, one square at a time, drawn the way a 1987 PC drew it.
tips: Fighters front, casters back. Gorm front.
Map as you go. Dungeon loops.
chat: Gorm found 16 colours. Gorm likes magenta.
Wizard cast fireball. Gorm's beard: fine. Mostly.
Gorm hit a door. Door was locked. Now door is not door.
nudge: Gorm axe is sharp. You come?
idle: {ago}! Gorm waited. Gorm sharpened axe 40 times.
Gorm bored for {ago}. Gorm hit wall for fun.
progress: Party at depth {floor}! Gorm proud! DEEPER!
update: GORM HEARD NEWS! PixelCrypt is v{version}!
